cohort: A single case of a fetus with Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (FVM) caused by multiple umbilical cord abnormalities identified through antenatal ultrasound Doppler.
finding: The report demonstrates a case of Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (FVM) caused by multiple umbilical cord abnormalities, discusses its chronic association with cerebral palsy, and compares ultrasonographic findings to pathologic findings.
